title: AYO ^ drops a new banger track "Way Up"
htmlContent:
AYO ^'s "Way Up" is brilliant story telling matched with true soul to make it resonate to the fullest. The intricacies in the writing are superb to bring the vision to us, while letting his artistry bring us a masterpiece for us to enjoy every aspect of.

Hit play now and enjoy this major sound by this major talent.

His music sticks with you for many different reasons, with the talent being clear every time you hear him, but something he is most masterful at is making music you can feel.
